papers.title: Redundant or Necessary? A Benchmark for Detecting Redundant Steps in Agent Trajectories

summary.en: RedundancyBench annotates 3,613 steps across 1,920 agent trajectories to test detection of computationally redundant actions. The revised paper evaluates six frontier LLMs and Jev and finds the task difficult without prior information. Its May v1 date is retained: this is a newly discovered Jev evaluation in a later revision, not a new May Jev release.

papers.title: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration

summary.en: This revised study integrates Jev into edge-service admission through four to eight bounded intent fields, comparing it with two local decision models and three hosted LLMs on 8,280 verified requests. summary.en: The revised study compares Jev and other decision models with generative LLMs on RAN intent interpretation, closed-loop simulation, and a real A1/E2 path. papers.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context

summary.en: Visual Jev encodes an image and shared context once, batches isolated question suffixes, and reads candidate probabilities from an existing language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training improves macro accuracy mainly on represented task families; at 32 questions per image, shared execution is substantially faster than serial or prefix-recomputing baselines but uses more peak memory. A matched typed-head control adds no consistent accuracy advantage, making shared computation the paper's supported contribution.
summary.zh: Visual Jev 只编码一次图像和共享上下文，将相互隔离的问题后缀组成批次，并从现有语言模型头读取候选概率。在四个基准上，答案监督的后训练主要提高了已有任务类型的宏平均准确率；每幅图像对应 32 个问题时，共享执行明显快于串行或重复计算前缀的基线，但峰值内存更高。条件匹配的类型化输出头对照并未带来稳定准确率优势，因此证据主要支持共享计算的贡献。

papers.title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents

summary.en: REFLEX uses Jev for bounded agent decisions and falls back to a strong generative model when confidence is low or generation is necessary. summary.en: This evaluation compares Jev with sixteen generative and reward-model judges using blinded human adjudication. summary.en: NumericJev turns numerical prediction into repeated range choices, enabling any LLM with a Jev-like structured-choice interface to refine values through a multiway decision tree without training or hidden-state access. Learn Then Test reduces observed target-risk violations to 7.8% of defined settings, compared with roughly half for naive threshold selection. Its finite-sample framework distinguishes useful-action coverage from probability calibration and relies on the stated statistical assumptions.

summary.en: MJev-Spatial uses native attention projections to score spatial choices, numeric bins and image regions without adding parameters. Trained on 12.3 million converted spatial question-answer pairs, it leads seven of twelve evaluated benchmarks and reports faster inference than autoregressive baselines. papers.title: What Can't Jev Decide? Probing the Limits of One-Pass Decision Models

summary.en: The authors probe where hosted Jev and open replicas fail at one-pass choice. Jev solves most items a reference LLM can answer without deliberation, but accuracy falls on items requiring more reasoning. Confidence is especially unreliable when the supplied agent state is stale.
summary.zh: 作者评估托管 Jev 与开源同类模型的单次选择能力。参考大模型无需推理即可回答的题目，Jev 大多能解决；需要更多推理时，准确率下滑。若智能体传入的状态已过时，置信度尤其难以预警。

papers.title: System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache

summary.en: System X adds a reply option to an LLM-based Jev-style readout and reuses the decision context's KV cache when that option is selected. Matched tests show reduced latency. Reply-quality comparisons have prompt and output-budget differences, and unsupported details remain a failure mode.
summary.zh: System X 在基于大模型的 Jev 式读出中增加回复选项，选中后复用决策上下文的 KV 缓存。匹配实验显示延迟降低。回复质量对比受提示和输出预算差异影响，且仍可能生成缺乏依据的细节。

papers.title: P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models

summary.en: The study uses binary probabilities from frozen decision models to score complete puzzle solutions during test-time search. Jev, Clef and other hosted systems solve more puzzles with this extra computation. The results quantify a quality–compute trade-off on the tested puzzle family.
summary.zh: 该研究用冻结决策模型的二元概率评价完整谜题解，在测试时展开搜索。Jev、Clef 等托管模型借此解出更多谜题。实验量化了这类谜题上计算开销与解题质量的权衡。

papers.title: Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions

summary.en: This paper proposes a narrower System One architecture for caller-defined choices and scores, emphasizing invariance to option order. The authors verify the invariances numerically and test routing and legal classification. Agreement with the production legal classifier is a proxy for task performance.
summary.zh: 论文提出用于调用方自定义选项和评分的窄型 System One 架构，重点考察选项顺序不变性。作者进行数值验证，并测试路由和法律文本分类。在法律任务中，与现有生产分类器的一致性仅是任务表现的代理指标。

papers.title: Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-Makers

summary.en: The authors ask Jev to answer from a reasoning model's unfinished trace, measuring when a cheap decision can replace further generation. A policy chosen on training folds saves an estimated 71.3% of full-run cost on held-out folds at a 0.58-point accuracy loss.
summary.zh: 作者让 Jev 根据大模型未完成的推理轨迹作答，衡量低成本决策何时可以替代后续生成。基于训练折选出的策略在留出折上估计节省 71.3% 的完整运行费用，准确率下降 0.58 个百分点。

papers.title: UniJev: Separating Accuracy from Calibration in Trimodal System One Decision Models

summary.en: UniJev trains typed decisions across text, images and video and compares accuracy and calibration effects of its training stages. The proposed confidence objective aligns scores with empirical accuracy within confidence bins. At 2B and 9B, the authors report better visual calibration with similar accuracy.
summary.zh: UniJev 在文本、图像和视频上训练类型化决策，并比较各训练阶段对准确率与校准的影响。置信度目标使区间内的评分贴近实测准确率。作者报告 2B 与 9B 模型的视觉校准改善，准确率基本保持。

papers.title: A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers

summary.en: This audit measures how seller-controlled presentation shifts recommendations made by shopping agents. The authors compare cues across generative models and hosted Jev using controlled stimuli. Jev is relatively insensitive to many tested cues but remains responsive to strong social proof.
summary.zh: 该审计用受控材料衡量卖家控制的商品展示如何影响购物智能体推荐，并在生成模型与托管 Jev 之间比较线索的影响。Jev 对许多受测线索较不敏感，但仍会受到较强社会认同线索的影响。

papers.title: Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality

summary.en: The authors evaluate how decision models respond when logged actions conflict with observed outcomes. A lightweight evidence check improves task completion in several agent environments with simulated silent failures. The study also finds that thresholds calibrated offline can transfer poorly to live trajectories.
summary.zh: 作者评估日志中的动作记录与实际观察结果冲突时，决策模型会如何选择。轻量证据检查提高了多个智能体环境在模拟静默失败下的任务完成率。离线校准的阈值迁移到在线轨迹时可能失效。

papers.title: NIOCIS: Typed-Decision Next-Hop Routing with Node-Conditioned Option Spaces for Tool-Use Agents

summary.en: NIOCIS restricts each tool-selection decision to actions associated with the current node in an execution graph. Ablations credit the narrower menu for improved agreement with reference actions. A confidence cascade performs worse when its escalation model is a weak zero-shot substitute.
summary.zh: NIOCIS 按执行图的当前节点缩小工具选择范围。消融实验将参考动作一致性的提升归于候选菜单收缩。当升级模型是较弱的零样本替代模型时，置信度级联反而降低一致性。

papers.title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency

summary.en: TimesJev learns to retain enough information from a time series for a short, typed decision. It compresses the sequence and aligns the selected representation with a decision model's embeddings. The authors compare accuracy and inference time with reasoning models across thirteen datasets.
summary.zh: TimesJev 学习保留序列中足以支持高效类型化决策的信息。它压缩时间序列，再将选出的表示与决策模型的嵌入空间对齐。作者在 13 个数据集上比较其与推理模型的准确率和推断耗时。

papers.title: Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems

summary.en: Decision4Rec uses knowledge and activity graphs to generate recommendation candidates and asks Jev-style models to score them. The authors compare hosted Jev with a trained 0.8B model and analyze where the gains originate. The trained model is competitive across the reported settings.
summary.zh: Decision4Rec 通过知识图和活动图生成推荐候选，再由 Jev 式模型打分。作者比较托管 Jev 与专门训练的 0.8B 模型，并分析收益来源。小模型在报告的多种设置下具有竞争力。

papers.title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift and Label Budgets: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors

summary.en: The study checks whether decision-specific training improves on the underlying model and how thresholds behave when class prevalence changes. It compares Jev and other decision models with recalibration and label-budget baselines. The useful option varies with both the task and available labels.
summary.zh: 研究检验决策专用训练相对基础模型的收益，以及类别占比变化时阈值的表现。实验比较 Jev 等决策模型、再校准和不同标注预算的基线。合适的选择取决于任务及标注量。

papers.title: SOMA: Continuous Monitoring and Intervention for System Two Reasoning with System One Models

summary.en: SOMA observes partial reasoning and calls a fast System One judge to signal when a slower model should stop or reconsider. A shared controller reduces reasoning length on overthinking tasks and raises abstention on unanswerable questions in the reported tests.
summary.zh: SOMA 监控尚未完成的推理，用快速 System One 模型判断慢模型何时应停止或重新考虑。实验中，共用控制器缩短了过度推理任务的轨迹，并提高了不可回答问题上的拒答率。

papers.title: Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models

summary.en: Using Jev and JevAny as motivating examples, the paper studies how teacher targets affect probabilities from candidate-scoring models. The analysis and empirical comparison indicate that recalibration can improve the probability scale while systematic teacher error still calls for validation against outcomes.
summary.zh: 论文以 Jev 与 JevAny 为例，研究教师监督信号如何影响候选打分模型的输出概率。理论分析与实证比较表明，再校准可以改善概率尺度，而教师的系统性偏差仍需用实际结果检验。

papers.title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records

summary.en: Clinical System One is trained to answer structured questions about patient records at scale. In a retrospective trial-screening experiment, its top-ranked records included more judged-eligible candidates than keyword search and required fewer language-model tokens than reading every record with an LLM.
summary.zh: Clinical System One 面向大规模病历训练结构化问答。在回顾性试验筛选实验中，它排名靠前的病历比关键词搜索包含更多被判定为符合条件的候选，使用的大模型词元也少于逐份阅读病历的方案。

papers.title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation

summary.en: CovNav tests adaptive model inference for object-goal navigation. A conformal rule invokes slow reasoning when a fast decision is uncertain. The study reports small navigation success gains on two HM3D versions, occasional escalation and additional experiments with a physical mobile robot.
summary.zh: CovNav 在目标物体导航中测试自适应推断，由保形规则根据快速决策的不确定性触发慢速推理。作者在两个 HM3D 版本上报告小幅成功率提升，慢速推理仅偶尔触发，并补充了实体移动机器人实验。

papers.title: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with a 500-Million-Persona Resource

summary.en: This household simulation combines a large synthetic persona resource with learned decision policies and explicit financial accounting. The authors evaluate prospective consumption predictions and sensitivity to information timing. Lower absolute error in one comparison coexists with an underestimated population mean.
summary.zh: 该家庭模拟结合大规模合成画像、学习所得的决策策略和显式财务记账。作者评估前瞻性消费预测及其对信息时点的敏感性。一项对比中的绝对误差有所下降，但总体均值仍被低估。

papers.title: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision

summary.en: The authors cast visual reranking as a typed decision and compare a pair of large vision-language decision models with dedicated rerankers. Gains vary across document pages and natural images. Differences in model scale and generation preclude attribution to decision training alone.
summary.zh: 作者将视觉重排表示为类型化决策，并用两个大型视觉语言决策模型与专用重排器比较。收益随文档页面和自然图像任务变化。模型规模与代际不同，结果难以归因于决策训练本身。

papers.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems

summary.en: DecisionPivot groups examples that differ in details intended to change the correct choice. This makes it possible to assess consistent reasoning and high-confidence errors alongside item accuracy. The benchmark reveals differences between decision models with otherwise similar aggregate scores.
summary.zh: DecisionPivot 将仅在关键细节上有所不同且正确选项应随之变化的样例分组，从而同时衡量单题准确率、判断一致性和高置信度错误。该基准揭示了总体成绩相近的决策模型之间的差异。

papers.title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI

summary.en: The authors compare Jev with generative judges on three clinical evaluation suites. They report similar criterion agreement and substantially lower fees and latency in the tested configuration. Agreement with another judge serves as the reference in some comparisons.
summary.zh: 作者在三组临床生成式 AI 评测中比较 Jev 和生成式评判模型。在受测配置中，Jev 的准则判断一致性相近，费用和延迟较低。部分对比以其他评判模型的判断为参照。

papers.title: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG

summary.en: The paper compares full-document decision-model scanning with lexical, dense and hybrid retrieval for long-document question answering. Evidence retention and answer quality are measured separately. Reusable indexes show a cost advantage as queries accumulate, while scanning incurs more latency on books.
summary.zh: 论文在长文档问答中比较决策模型全扫描与词法、稠密、混合检索，并分别测量证据保留率和回答质量。查询累计时，可复用索引更具成本优势；在书籍上，全扫描的延迟较高。

papers.title: Our Own Jev: Typed Decisions in One Forward Pass, from an In-House Judge to Open LoRA Models

summary.en: The authors develop open one-pass decision models from an internal judge and compare LoRA variants with hosted Jev and open alternatives. A small test finds the best model near the commercial reference, while retraining results expose sensitivity to the data release.
summary.zh: 作者以内部评判模型为起点开发开放的单次前向决策模型，并比较多种 LoRA 变体、托管 Jev 和开源替代模型。在小规模测试中最佳模型接近商业参照，重训结果则显示其对数据版本敏感。

papers.title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models

summary.en: This evaluation tests how Jev and other models distribute mass when more than one option is correct. Even identical correct options can receive very different probabilities. The resulting asymmetry can materially affect a pipeline that uses a threshold to recover multiple answers.
summary.zh: 该评测检验多个选项均正确时 Jev 与其他模型如何分配概率。即使候选文本完全相同，模型也可能赋予截然不同的概率。这种不对称性会影响使用阈值提取多个正确答案的流程。

papers.title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority

summary.en: The study compares System One decisions with generative models on legal cases in which a correct authority may be absent. Standard benchmark accuracy, abstention and wrong citations lead to different conclusions. Cross-model agreement reduces wrong citations in one tested policy.
summary.zh: 研究比较 System One 决策与生成模型在可能缺少正确法律依据的案件中的表现。常规准确率、拒答和错误引证给出的结论各异。一项以跨模型一致性为条件的策略降低了错误引证。

papers.title: Which Differences Matter? Controlled Tests of Rule Transfer, Joint Reliability, and Information Use in Decision Models

summary.en: Controlled changes to rules, wording and table entries let the authors test what drives typed choices beyond overall accuracy. Equivalent rewrites sometimes change outputs more than repeated identical inputs. Altering task-relevant table values more often shifts decisions in the expected direction.
summary.zh: 作者通过受控修改规则、表述与表内数值，检验总体准确率之外的类型化决策依据。同义改写引起的变化有时大于相同输入的重复调用；修改与任务有关的表内数值后，决策较常朝预期方向变化。

papers.title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage

summary.en: VX-One measures compact typed decision heads for defensive network-traffic triage. The authors compare classification and calibration with conventional detectors and check how performance changes over time. Probability calibration degrades sharply under temporal drift even where ranking retains some utility.
summary.zh: VX-One 评估用于防御性网络流量初筛的紧凑类型化决策头。作者比较分类、校准及传统检测器，并检验效果随时间的变化。即使排序仍有一定价值，概率校准也可能在时间漂移下显著变差。

papers.title: One Pretrained Decision Model Is Enough for Training-Free Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection

summary.en: Jev-GAD uses a pretrained decision model to judge node-level graph evidence and fuses its rankings with statistical anomaly scores. Tests across citation, social and review graphs evaluate whether the approach can generalize without fitting parameters to each anomaly dataset.
summary.zh: Jev-GAD 用预训练决策模型判断图结构中的节点级证据，再将其排序与统计异常得分融合。作者在引文、社交及评论图上检验该方法在无需对每个异常数据集重新训练参数时的泛化性。

papers.title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models

summary.en: RetiJev specializes a one-pass model for ophthalmic diagnosis, clinical choices and guideline grading. The authors report higher guideline-grading scores than a generative model and hosted Jev, plus faster inference. These are evaluations of bounded tasks using the paper's sources.
summary.zh: RetiJev 为眼科诊断、临床选择和指南评级训练单次前向模型。作者报告其在指南评级上超过生成模型和托管 Jev，并具有较快推断速度。评测范围限于论文所选来源和有界任务。

papers.title: ReDence: A Hybrid Agentic and Decision-Model Framework for Rapid, Evidence-Grounded Detection of Modern Social Engineering Scams

summary.en: ReDence combines a decision model with an investigative agent for defensive scam detection. It tests classification and latency on website workflows while producing reports that record supporting and contradictory evidence. The paper evaluates the approach as an aid for analyst review.
summary.zh: ReDence 将决策模型和调查型智能体结合，用于防御性的诈骗识别。系统在网站工作流上测试分类与延迟，并生成记录支持性及反向证据的报告。论文将其作为辅助分析人员复核的方法评估。

papers.title: The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine

summary.en: This medical benchmark compares System One models with generative relatives on structured decisions. Latency is consistently lower in the reported runs, but performance varies across languages and input types. Image interpretation and judgment-heavy tasks show larger limitations than text-based recall.
summary.zh: 该医学基准比较 System One 模型和同系列生成模型在结构化决策中的表现。报告的运行结果中延迟更低，但成绩随语言与输入类型变化。图像解读和依赖判断的题目比文本知识回忆任务更具挑战。

papers.title: How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification

summary.en: Four decision models are evaluated across thirteen Vietnamese zero-shot classification settings. The paper tests labels and input corruption as well as aggregate accuracy. Removing accents has a larger effect than the tested slang and typo modifications, showing the importance of language-specific robustness checks.
summary.zh: 作者在 13 种越南语零样本分类情境中评估四种决策模型，比较标签设计和输入扰动。去除变音符号比受测网络用语和拼写错误造成更大降幅，凸显语言特定稳健性检验的价值。

papers.title: Jev-DLC: Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback

summary.en: Jev-DLC records accepted and revoked choices as feedback for updating a compact personalization state. A chronological benchmark measures the effect of those events on later typed decisions. The reported gain over replay grows after the model observes more corrections.
summary.zh: Jev-DLC 将接受和撤销的选择记录为反馈，以更新紧凑的个性化状态。按时间排序的基准衡量反馈事件对后续类型化决策的影响。看到更多纠正后，相对于重放历史的优势有所扩大。

papers.title: System One models Are Not Better Rerankers

summary.en: Matched comparisons ask whether System One training transfers to passage reranking better than reranker-specific adaptation. Specialized rerankers usually retain an advantage in ranking quality. Decision-model calibration depends on how relevance is phrased and does not consistently offset inferior ranking.
summary.zh: 匹配对比检验 System One 训练能否比重排专用微调更好地迁移到段落重排。专用重排器通常在排序质量上占优。决策模型的校准表现随相关性问题的表述而变化，无法稳定弥补排序劣势。

papers.title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology

summary.en: PathJev learns to distribute probability over runtime-specified histopathology choices. The authors evaluate recognition, calibration and case abstention, including a whole-slide demonstration. Calibration can deteriorate on unseen organs, and a supervised pathology baseline is better calibrated in the reported settings.
summary.zh: PathJev 学习为运行时指定的组织病理候选分配概率。作者评估识别、校准及拒判，并演示全切片应用。陌生器官上的校准可能恶化，报告中监督式病理基线的校准更好。

papers.title: EditJev: System One Routing for Image Editing Models

summary.en: EditJev selects an image editor based on the input image and edit request, combining predicted preferences with editor speed. Two evaluations show small average quality gains over the strongest fixed editor and lower estimated end-to-end latency under the authors' configuration.
summary.zh: EditJev 根据输入图像和编辑指令选择编辑器，综合预测偏好与编辑器运行速度。两项评测中，平均质量略优于最强固定编辑器，在作者采用的配置下，端到端估计延迟也有所降低。

papers.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox

summary.en: A multilingual inbox study compares a hosted decision model with a classical classifier and a generative model under explicit costs for missed messages. Results change with the decision threshold and error cost. A later revision corrects threshold estimates based on incomplete data.
summary.zh: 该多语言收件箱研究比较托管决策模型、经典分类器和生成模型，并显式计算漏处理邮件的成本。结果随阈值和错误成本变化。后续修订纠正了源自不完整数据的阈值估计。

papers.title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation

summary.en: This moderation study separates annotator disagreement from the chance a model will make a wrong binary decision. The authors compare confidence signals and find that evaluating targeted subquestions can recover disagreement information for some models. Results depend on task decomposition and distribution.
summary.zh: 该内容审核研究区分标注者分歧和模型作出错误二元决策的风险。作者比较置信度信号，发现针对性子问题有助于部分模型捕捉分歧。效果取决于任务拆分方式和数据分布。

papers.title: OneCodeReviewBench: Typed Decisions for Code Review and Search

summary.en: OneCodeReviewBench evaluates bounded software-review and code-search decisions against engineered references and a smaller reviewer-checked subset. The reported experiments cover typed judgments and evidence retrieval with scope and agreement limitations. Repository-scale generalization remains outside the evidence.
summary.zh: OneCodeReviewBench 用工程化参考答案和较小的人工复核子集评估有界代码审查及代码搜索决策。实验覆盖类型化判断和证据检索，受任务范围与评审一致性限制。结果尚未验证仓库规模上的泛化能力。

papers.title: Benchmarking System One Models for Time-Series Decision Making: A Case Study of Jev

summary.en: This study evaluates hosted Jev on time-series tasks covering event prediction, numerical classification and market direction. Jev performs unevenly across the tasks, and candidate rankings can be stronger than final decisions. The authors identify temporal representations as a limitation worth testing.
summary.zh: 该研究在事件预测、数值序列分类和市场方向等时间序列任务上评估托管 Jev。其表现因任务而异，候选排序有时优于最终决策。作者指出时间表示能力值得进一步检验。

papers.title: Seeing the Options: What Should a Visual Candidate See?

summary.en: The authors compare ways to encode visual options for a single-pass decision, including state-conditioned candidate representations. The latter is order-stable in the reported tests, with some loss in ranking performance relative to joint encoding. Abstention thresholds can drift across settings.
summary.zh: 作者比较单次前向视觉决策的候选编码方式，包括由状态条件化的候选表示。报告中，该方式对顺序稳定，但相较联合编码损失部分排序性能。拒判阈值也可能随设置漂移。

papers.title: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection

summary.en: RoboJev uses a vision-language decision model to judge whether a robot has completed its goal. The authors release evaluation materials and compare against hosted vision models. The hosted baselines receive fewer frames, making that comparison sensitive to the input budget.
summary.zh: RoboJev 用视觉语言决策模型判断机器人是否完成目标。作者开放评测材料并比较托管视觉模型。由于托管基线接收的帧更少，该比较受输入预算影响。

papers.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS

summary.en: This tutorial surveys System One models, the caller-defined decision interface and practical evaluation topics such as calibration. It synthesizes prior work and includes a model inventory and worked examples. Its role is to orient readers to the literature and implementations.
summary.zh: 这篇教程综述 System One 模型、调用方定义的决策接口及校准等实际评测议题，并提供模型清单和实例。它综合既有文献，帮助读者了解研究和实现。

papers.title: Decision-Native Recommendation with Large Language Models

summary.en: A recommender scores a supplied menu directly as a decision task. The authors test reorderings, inference latency and whether confidence can route difficult examples to additional computation. The speed advantage is measured against the paper's evaluated generation-based methods.
summary.zh: 论文将推荐表述为对给定菜单直接打分的决策任务，检验候选重排、推断延迟以及能否按置信度为困难样例分配额外计算。速度优势参照论文所测试的生成式方法。

papers.title: SHIFT-JEV: Certified Abstention and Gain-Gated Continual Adaptation for LLM-Based Decision Models under Distribution Shift

summary.en: SHIFT-JEV combines selective prediction with adaptation when data distributions change. It tests prior-shift detection and compares gated adaptation with continual-learning baselines. Gains on a smaller backbone do not transfer uniformly to the larger backbone used in the paper.
summary.zh: SHIFT-JEV 将选择性预测与分布变化时的适应机制结合。论文测试类别先验变化检测，并与持续学习基线比较门控适应。在较小骨干上的收益未稳定迁移到论文所用的较大骨干。

papers.title: Entity Matching using Decision Models

summary.en: The authors test decision models on entity matching and send uncertain record pairs to generative judges. The cascade improves mean F1 for several stronger decision models. Results vary with the matching collection and prompt, and strongest published scores are exceeded on some benchmarks.
summary.zh: 作者评估决策模型对记录实体的匹配能力，并将置信度较低的记录对交给生成式评判模型。级联提高了若干强决策模型的平均 F1。结果随数据集和提示变化，部分基准超过已发表最高分。

papers.title: Can System-1-Style Decision Models Replace Dedicated Rerankers in RAG? A Systems Evaluation

summary.en: A systems evaluation compares decision-model reranking with dedicated rerankers on quality, latency and memory. Rankings change with the workload, and a tuned reranker is faster and more memory efficient in the tested setups. The paper documents conditions for a competitive alternative.
summary.zh: 这项系统评估比较决策模型与专用重排器的排序质量、延迟和显存。质量排序随工作负载变化，实验配置下调优后的重排器更快、更省显存。论文记录了决策模型具有竞争力的条件。

papers.title: TrustJev: Separating Policy Authority from Untrusted Evidence in LLM-Based Decisions

summary.en: TrustJev studies how a typed decision model can distinguish policy authority from untrusted evidence. The evaluation reports better reliability on an authorization benchmark and modest improvements on other tasks while maintaining similar median serving latency in the measured setting.
summary.zh: TrustJev 研究类型化决策模型如何区分政策权限与不可信证据。报告中，该方法在授权基准上提高可靠性，在其他任务上有小幅收益，并在测量条件下保持接近的服务延迟中位数。

papers.title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge

summary.en: RubriX is a non-autoregressive judge for choices among rubric levels. The authors compare its cached-response latency with Jev and a generative model as rubric descriptions grow. Its latency advantage is largest at the longest rubric lengths measured.
summary.zh: RubriX 是对量规等级进行选择的非自回归评判模型。作者比较其在使用缓存时与 Jev、生成模型的延迟，并拉长等级描述。其速度优势在受测最长量规上最明显。

papers.title: Decision Model Factory: Building Specialized Sovereign Decision Models

summary.en: The paper describes a workflow for building specialized decision models and a runner that computes probabilities over permitted answers while sharing context across questions. Experiments report throughput gains in matched multi-question workloads with similar decision scores.
summary.zh: 论文提出构建专用决策模型的流程及配套执行器。执行器计算允许答案的概率并在多个问题间复用上下文。匹配的多问题工作负载实验显示吞吐量增加，决策分数基本保持。

papers.title: JevVLA: Jev-Inspired Energy-Based Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Policies

summary.en: JevVLA applies a Jev-inspired energy-based decision layer to vision-language-action policies. The same framing covers discrete candidate actions and continuous guidance. The authors compare policy performance across several robot manipulation suites, with gains depending on the environment.
summary.zh: JevVLA 将受 Jev 启发的能量式决策层用于视觉语言动作策略，覆盖离散候选动作选择与连续引导。作者在多个机器人操作基准上比较策略表现，提升幅度随环境而异。

papers.title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation

summary.en: This study adapts NeoHorse decision models for entailment reranking. It compares selective adapter training and span-level aggregation with broader fine-tuning. The combined approach improves the reported aggregate benchmark while requiring fewer trained parameters than the all-module comparison.
summary.zh: 研究将 NeoHorse 决策模型适配到蕴含重排，比较选择性适配器训练、片段聚合与更广范围微调。两者结合改善了报告中的综合基准得分，且需训练的参数少于全模块对照。

papers.title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?

summary.en: The paper evaluates Jev on clinical-trial eligibility criteria, including judgments about missing information. It measures criterion-level performance and cost. Reported interpretation errors motivate checking flagged criteria against the underlying patient record in any review workflow.
summary.zh: 论文评估 Jev 对临床试验入组条件的判断，包括识别信息缺失，并按条件衡量表现和成本。报告中出现的证据解读错误表明，复核流程需将标记的条件与原始病历核对。

papers.title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?

summary.en: The authors test whether structured output protects Jev-style decisions from equivalent changes in presentation. Repeated calls can be stable even when equivalent presentations change selections. Voting brings limited gains, and unanimous decisions can still be incorrect in the tested conditions.
summary.zh: 作者检验结构化输出能否使 Jev 式决策抵抗语义等价的呈现变动。相同输入重复调用可能稳定，等价变体仍可改变选择。投票收益有限，受测条件下全票一致的结果也可能出错。

papers.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models

summary.en: DecisionRAG navigates document structures using decision-model judgments without training a first-stage retriever. The authors compare retrieval accuracy and latency with dense systems and rerankers across four benchmarks, including a large Wikipedia paragraph corpus.
summary.zh: DecisionRAG 用决策模型判断在文档结构中导航，无需另训首阶段检索器。作者在四个基准上与稠密检索系统和重排器比较召回表现与延迟，其中包括大规模维基百科段落集。

papers.title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine

summary.en: This MedJev study benchmarks available System One models on zero-shot clinical decisions. It measures predictive performance, serving cost and calibration, including a small-label recalibration experiment. The evaluation supports research baselines for local assessment across clinical populations.
summary.zh: 这项 MedJev 研究评估现有 System One 模型的零样本临床决策能力，衡量预测表现、服务成本和校准，并测试少量标注下的再校准。评测为不同临床人群的本地验证提供研究基线。

papers.title: Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models

summary.en: A comparison of hosted Jev and Laya separates confidence calibration, selective accuracy and explanation fidelity. Point-estimate thresholds frequently miss their stated accuracy target across the reported evaluations. Validation using lower bounds supports more conservative decisions about when to abstain.
summary.zh: 托管 Jev 与 Laya 的对比区分置信度校准、选择性准确率和解释忠实度。在报告的评测中，仅用点估计选阈值经常达不到预定准确率。以置信下界进行验证有助于更稳妥地确定何时拒判。

papers.title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models

summary.en: A learned formalizer translates open-ended workloads into questions a fast decision model can answer. The study tests this division of labor in robot-task evaluation using privileged states. Reported gains depend on the formalizer, with success remaining limited on the evaluated split.
summary.zh: 学习得到的形式化模块把开放式任务改写为快速决策模型可回答的问题。研究在使用特权状态的机器人任务中测试这一分工。报告的收益依赖该模块，评测划分上的任务成功仍有限。

papers.title: PsyJev: Psychological Analysis via System-1 Judgment

summary.en: PsyJev trains compact decision models to make structured judgments for psychological-analysis tasks. The authors compare model sizes and examine the effects of training stages on F1 and probability quality. The findings apply to the paper's benchmark rather than clinical diagnosis.
summary.zh: PsyJev 训练紧凑决策模型，对心理分析任务作出结构化判断。作者比较模型规模，并检验训练阶段对 F1 和概率质量的作用。结论适用于论文基准。

papers.title: DFIP: Decision-Focused Inference Path for System One Models

summary.en: DFIP investigates serving optimizations for System One model inference, comparing fixed-shape replay with diverse request arrivals. Some optimizations accelerate narrowly matched workloads, while mixed traffic exposes latency, numerical and reliability limitations. The reported gains depend on serving conditions.
summary.zh: DFIP 研究 System One 模型的服务优化，比较固定形状重放与多样化请求。部分优化在特定工作负载下提速，但混合流量暴露了延迟、数值和可靠性限制。报告中的收益取决于服务条件。

papers.title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG

summary.en: The authors test decision models on labeling conflicts among sources in retrieval-augmented generation. They analyze order sensitivity and distinguish hard labels from the usefulness of the underlying scores. The generative comparison is stronger at identifying planted false sources as hard labels.
summary.zh: 作者评估决策模型在检索增强生成中的来源冲突分类能力，分析顺序敏感性，并分别考察硬标签和底层分数。对预先植入的错误来源，生成式对照的硬分类表现更好。

papers.title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation

summary.en: JevRec uses a Jev-like decision head to separate item-code length decisions from content prediction while sharing the user's interaction representation. The study reports recommendation gains on three public datasets and investigates runtime and gradient interference relative to TIGER.
summary.zh: JevRec 用类似 Jev 的决策头将物品编码长度判断与内容预测分开，两者共享用户历史表示。研究在三个公开数据集上报告推荐收益，并与 TIGER 比较运行时间和梯度干扰。

papers.title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection

summary.en: This paper compares decision models with generative judges on several hallucination categories. A confidence-based cascade improves the strongest single decision model on some categories at lower reported cost than a frontier judge. Accuracy and confidence discrimination vary by category.
summary.zh: 论文在多类幻觉上比较决策模型与生成式评判模型。以置信度触发的级联在部分类型上超过最强单一决策模型，报告成本低于前沿评判模型。准确率及置信度区分能力随类别变化。

papers.title: One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them

summary.en: This preregistered comparison applies a shared confidence threshold to three typed decision services across 51 languages. Correct English inputs clear the threshold more often than equivalent non-English inputs. Translation reduces much of the gap at the tested threshold, with residual differences at matched error targets.
summary.zh: 这项预注册研究在 51 种语言和三种类型化决策服务上采用共同置信阈值。正确回答的英语输入比等价非英语输入更常通过阈值。翻译缩小受测阈值下的大部分差距，但匹配错误率时仍有差异。

papers.title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions

summary.en: ThinkJev learns to supply a decision with different amounts of intermediate reasoning. The experiments separate low confidence from the expected benefit of thinking, which do not reliably align. Comparisons on public JevBench items are reported as exploratory.
summary.zh: ThinkJev 学习以不同长度的中间推理辅助决策。实验分别衡量低置信度和追加推理的预期收益，两者并不稳定一致。公开 JevBench 题目上的对比属于探索性结果。

papers.title: Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval

summary.en: The study predicts which retrieved passages answer engines will cite under controlled retrieval. It compares rerankers, Jev and students trained on model or observed labels. Part of the apparent student advantage disappears when Jev uses the same pointwise scoring format.
summary.zh: 研究在受控检索条件下预测答案引擎会引用哪些段落，比较重排器、Jev 和使用模型标签或观察标签训练的学生。当 Jev 采用相同的逐段打分格式时，学生的部分表面优势消失。

papers.title: DecisionUnlearn-Bench: Unlearning Probabilistic Decisions under Changing Schemas

summary.en: DecisionUnlearn-Bench evaluates unlearning in models that return probabilities over changing option schemas. It compares with a retraining reference and measures forgetting, retained utility and subsequent adaptation separately. Conclusions differ according to the architecture and the selected metric.
summary.zh: DecisionUnlearn-Bench 评估在选项模式变化时输出概率的决策模型遗忘能力。研究以重训模型为参照，分别测量遗忘、保留能力和后续适应。结论随架构和所用指标变化。

papers.title: Predict the Reward, Not the World: World Reward Models for ML Agents

summary.en: The authors train a decision-based reward model to compare candidate machine-learning programs using outcomes from executed examples. It is evaluated on held-out task pairs and embedded in several research agents. The authors report faster task completion with similar or better average scores.
summary.zh: 作者用已执行样例的结果训练决策式奖励模型，对候选机器学习程序进行比较。研究在留出任务对上评测，并将模型接入多个研究智能体。报告显示任务完成更快，平均成绩相近或更高。

papers.title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions

summary.en: This evaluation compares decision and generative models on medical multiple-choice questions, including repeated runs and probability reliability. Decision models reduce compute and serving costs in the test, while the best generative model achieves higher accuracy. Repeatable labels can accompany differing probabilities.
summary.zh: 评测在医学选择题上比较决策与生成模型，考察重复运行及概率可靠性。受测决策模型的计算和服务成本较低，最强生成模型准确率更高。标签重复一致时，概率仍可能变化。

papers.title: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents

summary.en: The paper adds a typed decision gate and executable verification to tool-using agents. It compares the effect on task reliability across model and benchmark combinations. Gains are more consistent on the telecommunications and function-calling evaluations than on the airline tasks.
summary.zh: 论文为调用工具的智能体加入类型化决策门控和可执行验证，比较多种模型与基准组合上的可靠性。相较航空任务，在电信和函数调用评测上的收益更一致。

papers.title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev

summary.en: The authors evaluate whether Jev gives mutually consistent answers when the same judgment is cast as different decision primitives. They introduce an evaluation suite and a consistency method, examining both agreement and task accuracy across in-domain and transferred settings.
summary.zh: 作者评估同一判断表示为不同决策原语时，Jev 的答案是否相互一致。论文提出评测集和一致性方法，并在域内及迁移设置下同时衡量答案一致性与任务准确率。

papers.title: SatOps-Decision: Low-Latency Discriminative Decisions for Onboard Satellite Communication Operations

summary.en: SatOps-Decision trains a compact decision model for bounded satellite communications operations. Local timing and accuracy experiments compare decision-only models with a generative backbone and use hosted Jev versions as accuracy references. The paper reports latency for the tested hardware and implementation.
summary.zh: SatOps-Decision 为有界的卫星通信操作训练紧凑决策模型。本地实验比较决策模型和生成骨干的耗时及准确率，并以托管 Jev 版本作准确率参照。延迟数据适用于受测硬件和实现。

papers.title: FlipJev: Fast Black-Box Red Teaming Finds Universal Adversarial Suffixes for Typed Decision Models

summary.en: FlipJev is a robustness evaluation of typed decision models under adversarial inputs. The study finds that observed failures can persist beyond the original task and argues for stronger evaluation. This entry records the security finding at the benchmark level.
summary.zh: FlipJev 在对抗性输入下评估类型化决策模型稳健性。研究发现部分失效可跨越原始任务，表明需要更严格的评估。

papers.title: Lev-3B: A Data Recipe for Compact Probabilistic Log Decision Models

summary.en: Lev-3B is a compact decision model for defensive analysis of system logs. The paper evaluates anomaly detection, behavior classification and confidence on familiar and held-out logging sources. Strong aggregate detection can coexist with confident misses on an excluded source.
summary.zh: Lev-3B 是用于防御性系统日志分析的紧凑决策模型。论文在熟悉和留出的日志来源上评估异常检测、行为分类和置信度。总体检测表现较强时，留出来源仍可能出现高置信度漏报。

papers.title: When the Top Answer Decides: Gender Bias in Decision Models

summary.en: The authors audit demographic bias in hosted Jev and other decision models. They compare disparities in selected answers with disparities in the full probability distribution and find that the two views can disagree. Students of Jev also differ from it on this audit.
summary.zh: 作者审计托管 Jev 及其他决策模型的人口群体偏差，比较最终选项和完整概率分布所显示的差异，发现两种视角可以得出不同结论。Jev 的学生模型在该审计中也与教师存在差异。

papers.title: Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes

summary.en: The authors compare Jev-style and generative systems on rheumatology examination items and diagnostic vignettes. Strong decision scores on examination items do not carry over to vignettes. Jev's likelihood of being correct at high confidence also differs between the two settings.
summary.zh: 作者在风湿病学考试题和诊断病例上比较 Jev 式系统与生成式模型。考试题上的较好成绩未迁移至诊断病例，Jev 高置信度判断的正确率也随两类任务变化。

papers.title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support

summary.en: GDGraph represents radiology guidelines as decision graphs and guides a System One model through bounded decisions. The authors compare this workflow with unstructured and graph-guided generative baselines on selected categories of incidental findings, reporting gains in accuracy and serving efficiency.
summary.zh: GDGraph 将放射学指南表示为决策图，引导 System One 模型完成有界判断。作者在选定的偶发发现类别上与非结构化和图引导生成基线比较，报告准确率和服务效率的收益。

papers.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In

summary.en: This study evaluates whether an automated overseer can identify when an agent is about to breach an assigned policy. The reported warnings have limited lead time and frequent benign triggers. The results characterize trade-offs for oversight rather than demonstrating reliable automatic intervention.
summary.zh: 研究评估自动监督器能否预判智能体即将偏离既定政策。报告中的预警提前量有限，且常在正常情形触发。结果揭示监督流程中的取舍。

papers.title: CausalGrade: Evidence-Guided Causal Graph Scoring with Jev

summary.en: CausalGrade uses Jev to score candidate causal graphs against supplied evidence. Synthetic experiments relate scores to known structural errors and compare graph selection with a self-compatibility metric. The reported hit rate improves but leaves substantial room for incorrect selection.
summary.zh: CausalGrade 使用 Jev 依据给定证据为候选因果图打分。合成实验分析分数与已知结构误差的关系，并与自兼容指标比较图选择。报告命中率有所上升，但仍会选错较多样例。

papers.title: PathoJev: Efficient Pathology Decisions from Shared Visual Context

summary.en: PathoJev reuses visual context when answering multiple pathology questions as typed judgments. The authors compare it with a whole-slide baseline and measure shared encoding across workload sizes. The strongest speedups are reported for the larger batches of questions.
summary.zh: PathoJev 利用同一视觉上下文回答多个类型化病理问题。作者与全切片基线比较，并测量不同负载规模下共享编码的效果。问题批次较大时报告的加速最明显。

papers.title: EDU-Jev Training System-One Decision Models for Education

summary.en: EDU-Jev trains decision models at three sizes for rubric judgments and other educational assessment tasks. The 4B checkpoint leads the reported in-domain education comparison. The strongest commercial baseline remains more capable on general decision and reasoning tasks.
summary.zh: EDU-Jev 训练三种规模的决策模型，处理量规判断等教育评估任务。4B 版本在报告的域内教育对比中领先。最强商业基线在通用决策与推理任务上仍表现更好。

papers.title: When Disclosure Is Compulsory: Evaluating Ride-Hailing Rebalancing Policies with Self-Interested LLM Driver Agents

summary.en: This ride-hailing simulation uses decision-capable driver agents to evaluate rebalancing under compulsory disclosure. Driver responses alter economic and service outcomes relative to full compliance. Simulated results depend on the modeled driver incentives and the tested platform policies.
summary.zh: 该网约车模拟用具备决策能力的驾驶员智能体评估强制披露下的运力再平衡。与完全遵从相比，司机选择会改变经济和服务结果。模拟结论取决于所用司机激励模型及受测平台政策。

papers.title: Beyond CLIP: Calibrated (Few-Shot) Defect Detection With System One Decision Models

summary.en: The authors evaluate System One models and CLIP on visual defect detection, testing small numbers of labeled examples and calibration. Calibration improves Brier scores in most of the reported setups. The experiments document model and application combinations rather than one universal threshold.
summary.zh: 作者在视觉缺陷检测中评估 System One 模型与 CLIP，考察少样本标注与校准。报告中，多数受测配置的 Brier 分数因校准而改善。实验记录了不同模型和应用组合的表现。

papers.title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents

summary.en: Operon-S1 studies a fast typed controller for long-horizon scientific agents. The authors treat controller judgments as an independently measurable part of the workflow and assess how it can steer a slower model across bounded decisions in biomedical research tasks.
summary.zh: Operon-S1 研究用于长程科学智能体的快速类型化控制器。作者将控制器判断作为可独立衡量的工作流环节，评估它在生物医学研究任务的有界决策中如何引导较慢模型。

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers

summary.en: DecisionRank distills a generative ranking teacher into models that score supplied candidates directly. The authors evaluate on several retrieval benchmarks and compare both trained objectives and serving speed. Reported gains include settings where the student exceeds its larger teacher.
summary.zh: DecisionRank 将生成式排序教师蒸馏为可直接为给定候选打分的模型。作者在多个检索基准上评估训练目标与服务速度。报告的收益包括学生超过更大教师的设置。

papers.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking

summary.en: Flide specializes decision serving by sharing the computation of common input state across choices. The study compares throughput and agreement with a numerical reference against general inference engines. Reported speedups depend on how much candidate inputs can share.
summary.zh: Flide 通过跨选项复用共同输入状态的计算优化决策推断。研究与通用推断引擎比较吞吐量及对数值参照的吻合度。报告的加速取决于候选输入能共享多少计算。

papers.title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers

summary.en: The authors assess whether rewriting AI text to sound more human preserves facts and changes detector judgments. Decision-model judging is evaluated alongside other detectors. Detection performance falls sharply on some controlled rewrites, so evaluations using only original text can overstate reliability.
summary.zh: 作者评估将 AI 文本改写得更像人类表达后，事实是否保留及检测器判断是否改变，并比较决策模型评判与其他检测器。部分受控改写使检测性能明显下滑，仅用原文评测可能高估可靠性。

papers.title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?

summary.en: This study tests scientific judgments on optical spectra presented in equivalent forms, and checks how models respond when essential evidence is missing. Its comparison includes decision-model baselines and reports that good performance on fully specified spectra can mask reliance on shortcuts.
summary.zh: 研究以等价形式呈现光谱，检验模型的科学判断是否一致，以及关键证据缺失时的表现。实验包含决策模型基线，并指出完整光谱上的良好表现可能掩盖对捷径的依赖。

papers.title: Swap, Replicate, Read the Mass: A Protocol for Auditing Demographic Bias in System One Decision Models

summary.en: The authors audit demographic disparities in System One models while varying question framing and option order. They distinguish final selections from probability mass and use multiple runs. The observed disparities can depend strongly on both presentation and how decisions are aggregated.
summary.zh: 作者通过改变问题表述和候选顺序来审计 System One 模型的人口群体差异，并在多次运行中分别分析最终选择和概率质量。观察到的差异会受呈现方式与决策汇总方法影响。

papers.title: To Jev or Not to Jev: When Can System-1 Decision Models Replace LLM Judges?

summary.en: This benchmark asks when Jev and other decision-only systems can replace generative judges. It distinguishes simple preferences from correctness tasks requiring reasoning and measures a cascade that sends difficult items to a stronger judge. Capability and serving trade-offs vary by evaluation.
summary.zh: 该基准考察 Jev 等决策模型何时可替代生成式评判者，区分简单偏好与需要推理的正确性任务，并测量将困难样例交给更强模型的级联。能力与服务开销的权衡因评测而异。

papers.title: Trail: Accurate Local Smart Home Control Using Decision Models

summary.en: Trail uses hierarchical typed decisions to resolve room, device and operation in a local smart-home registry. The study compares the method with a fine-tuned generative baseline, including robust and conversational requests. Memory particularly helps when an instruction depends on earlier exchanges.
summary.zh: Trail 用层级化决策在本地智能家居注册表中依次确定房间、设备与操作。研究与微调生成基线比较，包括稳健性和多轮请求。指令依赖前序对话时，记忆模块的帮助较明显。

papers.title: Can Jev Improve Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Learning?

summary.en: The authors apply Jev's probabilistic judgments to choosing demonstrations for in-context learning and distill those judgments into a smaller ranking model. The study assesses how the selected demonstrations affect downstream performance and compares efficient retrieval with repeated direct Jev calls.
summary.zh: 作者用 Jev 的概率判断为上下文学习选择示例，并将这些判断蒸馏到较小的排序模型。研究检验所选示例对下游表现的影响，并比较高效检索和重复调用 Jev。

papers.title: Decision-Centric Research: A Calibrated Decision Model and Benchmark for Scientific Agents

summary.en: DCRM studies scientific-agent decisions conditioned on the current research state. Its benchmark evaluates prediction and uncertainty, including conformal sets that can retain several candidates. In the reported holdout, using the state reduces set size at similar empirical coverage.
summary.zh: DCRM 研究以当前研究状态为条件的科学智能体决策。其基准评估预测与不确定性，并允许保形预测集保留多个候选。作者报告，在留出数据中，使用状态可在相近覆盖率下缩小预测集。

papers.title: S1CogBench: What System One Decision Models Can and Cannot Do on Cognitive Experiments

summary.en: S1CogBench evaluates System One models on tasks drawn from cognitive experiments. The study separates capability differences from latency associated with output generation and includes matched short-output comparisons. Its task-level results characterize how far the decision format generalizes across tested cognitive settings.
summary.zh: S1CogBench 在源自认知实验的任务上评估 System One 模型。研究区分能力差异和输出生成延迟，并包含匹配的短输出对照。分任务结果描述了决策形式在受测认知场景中的适用范围。

papers.title: IJev: Order-Invariant Decisions via Iterated Cyclic Reordering

summary.en: IJev combines decisions across cyclic arrangements of the same option set. The authors evaluate accuracy, calibration and option-order flips across five models and five benchmarks. The method removes measured flips in these tests, with extra calls as its main cost.
summary.zh: IJev 汇总同一候选集合在不同循环排列下的判断。作者在五种模型和五个基准上评估准确率、校准和换序翻转。受测设置中的翻转被消除，主要代价是增加模型调用。

papers.title: Do GEO Gains Survive the Live Web? Evaluating In-the-Wild Visibility Gains of Generative Engine Optimization via LIVE-GEO

summary.en: LIVE-GEO tests whether content optimization gains survive live retrieval. It also uses Jev to verify the numerical faithfulness of rewritten descriptions. The authors check a subset against human labels and report that a substantial number of rewrites are flagged.
summary.zh: LIVE-GEO 检验内容优化的收益能否延续到在线检索，并用 Jev 核验改写描述中的数值忠实度。作者用人工标签检查部分样例，报告有相当数量的改写被标记为存疑。

papers.title: XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages

summary.en: XDecideBench compares typed decisions and confidence policies across languages and benchmarks. Model rankings can change considerably with language and task. Thresholds chosen on English also fail to preserve the intended error rate on several transferred test settings.
summary.zh: XDecideBench 跨语言、跨基准比较类型化决策和置信度策略。模型排名会随语言与任务明显变化。在英语数据上选定的阈值也难以在多个迁移设置中维持目标错误率。

papers.title: DIMWIT: Directly Invoking Models Without Intensive Tuning

summary.en: DIMWIT uses model calls for individual resource-management decisions and evaluates the trade-off between execution time and output quality. The authors report faster encoding in one video workload with a small drop in the measured perceptual quality score.
summary.zh: DIMWIT 为单项资源管理决策调用模型，评估执行时间和输出质量之间的权衡。作者在一种视频负载上报告了编码提速，所测感知质量分数略降。

papers.title: Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks

summary.en: The paper uses single-token readouts from open vision-language models to evaluate zero-shot System One-style decisions in radiology. It compares response bias and accuracy among tasks. No tested model leads on every task, and answer preferences can be strongly task-specific.
summary.zh: 论文用开源视觉语言模型的单词元读出评估放射学零样本 System One 式决策，比较多个任务上的答案偏好和准确率。受测模型无法在所有任务中领先，答案偏好可能高度依赖任务。

papers.title: EarthJev: Calibrated, Non-Generative Answers to Natural-Language Questions about Sentinel-2 Land Cover

summary.en: This EarthJev model answers Sentinel-2 land-cover questions by selecting among supplied options and estimating probabilities. Ablations test how much non-RGB spectral information contributes. The authors report both calibration and accuracy, including a comparison with end-to-end visual adaptation.
summary.zh: 该 EarthJev 模型从给定候选中选择答案并估计概率，用于 Sentinel-2 土地覆盖问答。消融检验额外光谱波段的贡献，作者报告校准和准确率，并与端到端视觉适配比较。

papers.title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms

summary.en: The authors evaluate decision models as policy gates for coding agents. They compare explicit boundary descriptions with less specific policies and measure recall and unnecessary interruptions. The follow-up uses new scenarios, supporting the value of stating policy boundaries clearly.
summary.zh: 作者将决策模型作为编程智能体的策略门控，比较明确边界和较模糊规则对召回率及不必要干预的影响。使用新场景的后续实验支持明确表达策略边界的价值。

papers.title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs

summary.en: RLiD trains an agent's decision model with reinforcement learning over actions and transfers the policy to a generative model. ALFWorld experiments compare success and training compute with token-level reinforcement learning, with additional results for a version that uses compiled memory.
summary.zh: RLiD 在动作层对智能体决策模型做强化学习，再将策略迁移给生成模型。ALFWorld 实验比较了与词元级强化学习的成功率和训练开销，还报告使用编译记忆版本的结果。

papers.title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities

summary.en: This security audit assesses whether confidence can identify compromised typed decisions. Model scores can retain useful ranking information even when a monitor misses cases at its selected alarm budget. The distinction matters when interpreting AUROC for a deployed screening policy.
summary.zh: 该安全审计检验能否借助置信度识别受干扰的类型化决策。即使在设定告警预算下监控漏报，模型分数仍可能保留一定排序信息。部署筛查策略时，这一区别影响对 AUROC 的解读。

papers.title: VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement

summary.en: VerdictAD uses a decision model to refine scores from visual anomaly detectors with few labeled examples. The authors test the refinement across three industrial inspection datasets and compare several detector backbones, reporting consistent improvements in their evaluated settings.
summary.zh: VerdictAD 用决策模型在少量标签下细化视觉异常检测器的分数。作者在三组工业质检数据上测试，并比较多种检测骨干。受测设置中报告了稳定收益。

papers.title: Cyber-JEV: Matched Contrastive Fine-Tuning of Language Models for Fast Source-Code Vulnerability Triage

summary.en: Cyber-JEV studies decision models for prioritizing code review and compares learned rankings for paired vulnerable and fixed versions. The reported tests measure whether changed functions can be ranked for analyst follow-up when review capacity is limited.
summary.zh: Cyber-JEV 研究用决策模型安排代码复核优先级，比较存在漏洞与已修复版本的成对排序。实验衡量在复核容量有限的情况下，能否为分析人员安排变更函数的复查顺序。

papers.title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions

summary.en: This reranking method divides instructions into individual clauses and combines separately judged probabilities. The paper evaluates instruction sensitivity and rank quality, showing that the measured effect depends partly on whether an evaluation compares raw scores or induced ranks.
summary.zh: 该重排方法将指令拆成独立子句，再合并逐项判断的概率。论文评估指令敏感性和排序质量，发现部分效果取决于评测使用原始分数还是由其产生的排序。

papers.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry

summary.en: Kev-Bio frames ultrasound landmark localization as a decision over image positions. The authors evaluate the approach for several anatomical views and measure both landmark detection and downstream biometry. The comparison is confined to the datasets and tasks studied.
summary.zh: Kev-Bio 将超声地标定位表述为对图像位置的决策。作者在多个解剖切面评估地标检测与下游生物测量指标，比较范围限于研究采用的数据集和任务。

papers.title: EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation

summary.en: EO-Jev adapts general-purpose decision models to Earth observation and evaluates trade-offs with general ability. The paper tests perception, option consistency and calibration under shifts. The reported adapted models remain challenged by quantitative questions and distribution changes.
summary.zh: EO-Jev 将通用决策模型适配到地球观测，并评估对通用能力的影响。论文测试感知、选项一致性和分布变化下的校准。受测适配模型在定量问题和分布变化下仍面临挑战。

papers.title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation

summary.en: The authors train compact decision models for financial policy and realized outcomes. The study measures specialization costs across model sizes and tests mixed training data. Outcome predictions can be well calibrated around the base rate while carrying little discrimination.
summary.zh: 作者为金融规则判断和实际结果预测训练紧凑决策模型，跨规模衡量专业化代价，并测试混合训练数据。对实际结果的预测可能围绕基准率保持良好校准，却缺少足够的区分能力。

papers.title: JevBreak: Your Model, Their Decision

summary.en: JevBreak measures how reliably Jev and other typed decision models preserve intended judgments under adversarial inputs. It finds material differences between models and evaluates the limits of confidence thresholding. Results concern benchmark robustness rather than any guarantee of downstream safety.
summary.zh: JevBreak 衡量 Jev 等类型化决策模型在对抗输入下保持预期判断的能力。它报告模型间存在明显差异，并评估置信阈值的局限。结论针对基准中的稳健性。

papers.title: SLATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon API Selection in E-commerce Tool Use

summary.en: SLATE measures long-horizon selection of e-commerce APIs in a simulator. The benchmark compares decision models with the backbones they use and records end-to-end task completion, which is low even for the strongest tested system.
summary.zh: SLATE 在模拟环境中评估长程电商 API 选择，比较决策模型及其骨干，并记录端到端任务完成率。即使最强受测系统的整体完成率也较低。

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market

summary.en: The paper tests decision models on news-based market judgments under a preregistered protocol. Strategy results are evaluated after costs and robustness adjustments. The authors also find that identity masking can leave enough context for models to recover which company is involved.
summary.zh: 论文按预注册方案评估基于新闻的市场判断，纳入成本与稳健性调整后比较策略表现。作者还发现，遮盖公司名称后，上下文仍可能泄露足以识别公司的信息。

papers.title: Structured Clinical Memory as Context for Probabilistic Decision Models: A Synthetic Evaluation with Jev

summary.en: This synthetic pilot tests Jev with structured patient memory as the input state. It compares decisions under alternative context configurations. The labels come from one author and the memory represents an optimistic upper bound, limiting implications for clinical practice.
summary.zh: 这项合成试点评估将结构化患者记忆作为输入状态时的 Jev，比较不同上下文配置下的决策。标签由一位作者提供，记忆是理想条件下的上界，临床外推有限。

papers.title: ReListen: Training-Free Evidence Localization in Hour-Long Audio with Frozen Audio Language Models

summary.en: ReListen uses a frozen audio model to make bounded judgments about candidate segments when searching long recordings. It compares evidence localization, answering latency and memory with transcript-based approaches. The study demonstrates a decision-oriented use of audio models without additional training.
summary.zh: ReListen 用冻结音频模型对候选片段作有界判断，在长录音中寻找证据。它与转录式方案比较证据定位、作答延迟和内存占用，展示无需追加训练的音频决策应用。

papers.title: Fast, Cheap, and Fair? Evaluating Decision Models

summary.en: This hiring audit measures how counterfactual changes to CVs affect decision-model ratings and shortlists. It benchmarks those changes against variation from names and typos, and measures service costs. The observed disparities are tied to the tasks and model configurations tested.
summary.zh: 该招聘审计衡量反事实简历变体如何影响决策模型的评分及入围结果，参照姓名和拼写扰动造成的变化，并记录服务成本。观察到的差异依赖受测任务与模型配置。

papers.title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model

summary.en: Jev-AD pairs typed interpretation of passenger requests with forecasts from a language world model. Jev compares potential driving actions with forecast consequences. The authors report fewer collisions in simulation and recorded-traffic replay, with no direct deployment evidence in the study.
summary.zh: Jev-AD 将乘客指令的类型化理解与语言世界模型预测结合，由 Jev 比较候选驾驶动作及其预测后果。作者报告模拟和交通记录回放的碰撞更少，实验范围限于这些环境。

papers.title: Decision Models as Scalable Economic Surrogates that Capture Human Variation

summary.en: The authors compare decision and generative models as surrogates for human choices in economic games. They assess variation across people alongside aggregate agreement and inference costs. Decision models capture more of the tested variation while reducing the cost of repeated simulation.
summary.zh: 作者比较决策模型和生成模型在经济博弈中替代人类选择的能力，同时衡量个体差异、总体一致性和推断成本。决策模型在受测任务中捕捉到更多差异，并降低重复模拟开销。

papers.title: TACT: A Pragmatic Approach to Qualitative Analysis with an AI Council

summary.en: TACT combines several AI roles for qualitative analysis, using decision judgments as part of the workflow. It compares the outputs and costs of lighter and fuller configurations and discusses how researchers can inspect and validate thematic findings.
summary.zh: TACT 以多个 AI 角色协作完成定性分析，并将决策判断纳入工作流。论文比较较轻与完整配置的输出和成本，并讨论研究人员如何检查和验证主题分析结果。

papers.title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration

summary.en: TandemBench tests decision models on multi-agent coordination and separately asks whether the supplied options contain a good team plan. The authors find that overall selection accuracy can conceal systematic mistakes about the availability of an optimal arrangement.
summary.zh: TandemBench 在多智能体协同中评估决策模型，并单独检查模型能否判断候选中包含好的团队方案。作者发现，总体选择准确率可能掩盖对最优方案是否可用的系统性错误。

papers.title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages

summary.en: Zuse is a decision model designed for European languages. The authors compare it with hosted Jev and Kev and investigate data-integration issues such as collisions between label schemes. Strong performance in targeted categories is weighed against broader benchmark results.
summary.zh: Zuse 是面向欧洲语言的决策模型。作者与托管 Jev 和 Kev 比较，并调查多源数据整合中标签体系冲突等问题。评测同时衡量目标类别与更宽泛基准上的表现。

papers.title: Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation

summary.en: The study compares Jev, Clef Flash and Perplexity Decider on subjective text evaluation. Controlled presentation changes can shift scores and selections while leaving text unchanged. Agreement with people, repeatability and robustness to equivalent presentations are analyzed as separate properties.
summary.zh: 该研究比较 Jev、Clef Flash 与 Perplexity Decider 的主观文本评价表现。即使文本不变，受控呈现变化也可能改变分数和选项。论文分别分析与人的一致性、可重复性和对等价呈现的稳健性。

papers.title: Extending Reasoning in Typed Decision Models via Looping

summary.en: This study evaluates repeated processing in typed decision models on problems that require longer reasoning. It compares parameter sharing, additional training compute and adaptive execution. The reported improvements vary with problem length and the architecture of the decision backbone.
summary.zh: 研究在需要较长推理的问题上评估类型化决策模型的循环处理，比较参数共享、额外训练计算与自适应执行。报告的收益随题目长度和决策骨干架构而变化。

papers.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex

summary.en: Drex introduces open decision checkpoints and evaluates native typed outputs, speed and option-order stability. It includes comparisons with generative frontier models and systems from the same decision category. The reported timing refers to the authors' request workload and deployment.
summary.zh: Drex 提出开放决策模型版本，评估原生类型化输出、速度和顺序稳定性，并与生成式前沿模型及同类决策系统比较。报告的耗时适用于作者的请求负载与部署环境。

papers.title: AffordJEV: Affordance Grounding by Confirming Candidate Regions

summary.en: AffordJEV asks a System One judge to confirm which candidate image regions support a requested action. The authors compare decision and chain-of-thought approaches on affordance grounding, testing both in-domain performance and transfer to other image collections.
summary.zh: AffordJEV 用 System One 模型确认候选图像区域中哪些支持给定动作。作者在可供性定位中比较决策与思维链方法，测试域内表现以及对其他图像集合的迁移。

papers.title: The Blindfolded Controller: Decision Model-Guided Training for Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: This reinforcement-learning study uses a decision model to guide training while allowing the learned policy to act independently. The paper compares the learned policy, conventional reinforcement learning and the standalone decision model across seven tasks, with gains depending on the test.
summary.zh: 该强化学习研究用决策模型引导训练，训练后的策略可独立行动。论文在七个任务上比较学习所得策略、常规强化学习与单独决策模型，收益因任务而异。

papers.title: Probabilistic Relevance Decisions for Semantic Retrieval

summary.en: The authors use probabilistic relevance judgments to complement dense search and compare several candidate depths. Their protocol measures ranking and serving latency. Differences in runtime environments and the exploratory analysis limit broader calibration and efficiency claims.
summary.zh: 作者用概率相关性判断补充稠密搜索，并比较多种候选深度。实验衡量排序质量与服务延迟。由于运行环境差异及分析的探索性质，更广泛的校准和效率结论仍有限。

papers.title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection

summary.en: RouteAlign matches typed task requirements with model capability profiles to choose an LLM service. The authors test routing quality and cost, including a changing service catalog. Ablations highlight the role of observed local performance evidence in the fitted scorer.
summary.zh: RouteAlign 将类型化任务要求与模型能力档案匹配，以选择大模型服务。作者评估路由质量、成本以及服务清单变化下的复用能力。消融表明本地实测表现对拟合打分器很重要。

papers.title: Escalate or Close: How Fast-Tier Models Handle Held-Out Web Attack Families in Two-Tier Triage

summary.en: This defensive triage study compares fast models including Jev on previously unseen web-traffic categories. It examines which cases should reach a slower tier and whether evaluations transfer beyond known patterns. Overlapping benign traffic and repeat-call variation complicate deployment estimates.
summary.zh: 该防御性初筛研究比较 Jev 等快速模型在未见网页流量类别上的表现，考察何时交由慢速层以及能否迁移到已知模式之外。相似正常流量和重复调用差异使部署估计更复杂。

papers.title: Decision Models as Retrieval Gates Against Injection and Pollution

summary.en: The paper evaluates open decision models as defensive gates for retrieved web evidence. It measures filtering quality, answer coverage and cost under different candidate budgets and evidence formats. Narrow filtering can remove information the generator needs to produce an answer.
summary.zh: 论文评估用开放决策模型为网页检索证据加防御门控，比较不同候选预算和证据形式下的过滤质量、回答覆盖率与成本。候选范围过窄时，可能剔除生成器作答所需的信息。

papers.title: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes

summary.en: The authors compare versions of a typed-decision encoder trained with varied option wording. They test unfamiliar labels, abbreviations and codes, with gains concentrated in some language variations. Checkpoint rankings also differ across held-out datasets, complicating model selection.
summary.zh: 作者比较用不同候选措辞训练的类型化决策编码器，测试陌生标签、缩写和代码。收益集中在部分语言变化上。不同留出数据的检查点排名也不一致，增加模型选择难度。

papers.title: Jev as an LLM Safety Guardrail: An Empirical Study of Input Filtering, Selective Output Review, and Over-Refusal

summary.en: The authors test Jev for screening LLM prompts and selectively reviewing outputs. They compare safety outcomes, benign refusals and review workload under matched budgets. Adding an output stage helps some configurations, but the gains do not consistently transfer to held-out cases.
summary.zh: 作者评估 Jev 筛查大模型提示及选择性复核输出的效果，在匹配预算下比较安全结果、正常请求误拒和复核负担。输出阶段在部分配置有帮助，但收益未稳定迁移至留出样例。

papers.title: GeoJeV: Unified Spatial Probability for Training-Free Efficient Evidence Acquisition in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing

summary.en: GeoJeV uses spatial probability to choose which regions of very high-resolution remote-sensing imagery merit additional inspection. The authors report accuracy and latency across three benchmarks, comparing with both a single-pass base model and a slower evidence-acquisition method.
summary.zh: GeoJeV 使用空间概率选择超高分辨率遥感图像中值得进一步查看的区域。作者在三个基准上报告准确率和延迟，并与单次前向基线及较慢的证据获取方法比较。

papers.title: Same Facts, Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions

summary.en: This audit compares the effect of stylistic rewrites on individual decisions and aggregate group disparities in generative and System One models. Auditors check whether rewrites preserve material facts. Decision instability persists even when those checks do not flag a rewrite.
summary.zh: 该审计比较文风改写对生成模型及 System One 模型的个体决策和群体差异的影响。审计模型检查改写是否保留重要事实。即使未被标记为改变事实，改写仍可能导致决策波动。

papers.title: Nudging Decision Models: Do Digital Nudges Steer Fast, Generation-Free AI Agents?

summary.en: The authors compare how digital nudges affect generation-free decision agents and reasoning-capable language agents. They find the strength of particular tested nudges depends on the agent class. The results concern behavior on the paper's choice tasks.
summary.zh: 作者比较数字助推如何影响非生成决策智能体和具备推理能力的语言智能体。部分受测助推的作用强度取决于智能体类型。结果适用于论文中的选择任务。

papers.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model

summary.en: The authors evaluate how Maya a1 responds to reordered options and compare order aggregation with architectural choices intended to reduce sensitivity. The report quantifies additional compute alongside accuracy and flip rates. Model-generated labels and teacher-filtered datasets limit the evidence.
summary.zh: 作者检验 Maya a1 对候选换序的反应，并比较多顺序汇总和减弱敏感性的架构设计。报告同时量化额外计算、准确率与翻转率。模型生成标签和经过教师筛选的数据限制了证据范围。

papers.title: A Systematic Comparison of In-Context Learning Strategies for Peptide Property Prediction in Low-Data Regimes

summary.en: This benchmark compares typed decision models, language models and tabular foundation models with gradient-boosted trees on low-data peptide property classification. The authors report performance that varies by task and no significant overall advantage over classical baselines for in-context learning.
summary.zh: 该基准在低数据量的肽属性分类中比较类型化决策模型、语言模型、表格基础模型与梯度提升树。作者发现表现随任务变化，上下文学习相对经典基线未取得显著总体优势。

papers.title: EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding

summary.en: This EarthJev system decides where to acquire additional visual evidence for ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing questions. Experiments with several frozen answering models compare the controller with single-pass baselines. The reported gains use model-specific fitting and calibration.
summary.zh: 这项 EarthJev 系统针对超高分辨率遥感问题决定去哪里获取补充视觉证据。实验用多种冻结回答模型比较控制器和单次前向基线。报告中的收益基于分别拟合和校准各模型。

papers.title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening

summary.en: TrialJev scores patient–trial eligibility with an open single-pass architecture. The study measures ranking, decision accuracy and inference cost on synthetic cases. The authors position it as a prioritization aid for subsequent review and report timing for their specific implementation.
summary.zh: TrialJev 用开放的单次前向架构评估患者与试验的匹配资格。作者在合成病例上衡量排序、决策正确率和推断成本，将其定位为后续复核的优先级辅助工具，并报告特定实现的耗时。

papers.title: Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction

summary.en: The authors measure reproducibility in LoRA serving when different numerical reduction schedules propagate differences into decisions. A deterministic implementation maintains much of the latency advantage in the tested hardware setting. The study connects numerical variation to observable changes in outputs.
summary.zh: 作者测量 LoRA 服务的可重复性，检验不同数值归约顺序如何使差异传导至决策。在受测硬件条件下，确定性实现保留大部分速度收益。研究将数值变化与输出变化联系起来。

papers.title: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market

summary.en: This Jev-compatible trading simulation examines whether web news provides information beyond numerical features when publication lags market events. Its confirmatory test finds no incremental ranking information at the specified horizon. The paper also examines how decision records help audit results.
summary.zh: 该兼容 Jev 的交易模拟研究网页新闻晚于市场事件发布时，能否提供超出数值特征的信息。验证性实验在指定预测窗口未发现增量排序信息。论文还考察决策记录对结果审计的作用。

papers.title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models

summary.en: AbductionBench evaluates inference to plausible explanations, including whether agents request useful evidence and revise hypotheses. The study includes decision-model comparisons and analyzes behavior alongside final-answer accuracy. Models can retain an early hypothesis even as new observations arrive.
summary.zh: AbductionBench 评估模型推断合理解释的能力，包括智能体是否请求有用证据及修正假设。研究加入决策模型对比，将行为过程与最终答案准确率并列分析。新观察到来后，模型仍可能坚持早期假设。

papers.title: Evaluating Jev on Arabic: Comparing Decision Models and LLMs Across Arabic Tasks and Dialects

summary.en: The authors compare Jev with decision and generative alternatives on Arabic tasks and dialects. Task-family and matched-language breakdowns reveal variation obscured by aggregate scores. Some dialect comparisons remain inconclusive, limiting claims about a universal order of models.
summary.zh: 作者在阿拉伯语任务和方言上比较 Jev、其他决策模型及生成模型。分任务和匹配语言比较揭示总体分数未体现的差异。部分方言对比仍缺乏确定结果，难以给出普适模型排名。

papers.title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback

summary.en: DM-Call uses typed decision feedback to check and revise proposed function calls without executing them. The feedback combines probabilities with correctness labels. On the tested function-calling benchmarks, the method improves on direct generation while making additional model calls.
summary.zh: DM-Call 在无需执行函数的条件下，用类型化决策反馈检查和修改调用提案。反馈结合概率和正确性标签。在受测函数调用基准中，追加模型调用后，该方法的表现优于直接生成。

papers.title: LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting

summary.en: LoMASA uses a local decision model to delegate B2B quoting tasks according to confidence. The study measures calibration and the rate of low-margin deals alongside escalation workload. Gains depend on the model and the cost assigned to manager review.
summary.zh: LoMASA 用本地决策模型根据置信度分派企业报价任务。研究同时衡量校准、低利润交易比例和升级复核负担。收益取决于模型以及主管复核成本。

papers.title: NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification

summary.en: NuJEV combines candidate localization with typed visual judgments to count and classify cell nuclei. The authors evaluate dense images and natural-language requests and compare visual adaptation with matched alternatives. Measurements include localization and counting errors rather than only answer accuracy.
summary.zh: NuJEV 将候选定位与类型化视觉判断结合，对细胞核进行计数和分类。作者评估密集图像和自然语言请求，并比较视觉适配与匹配基线。指标涵盖定位和计数误差。

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?

summary.en: The paper evaluates decision models as relevance probability estimators as well as rerankers. It compares discrimination and Brier scores with generative and cross-encoder baselines, then uses calibrated probabilities to choose a cutoff per query. The conclusions apply to the evaluated retrieval sets.
summary.zh: 论文将决策模型同时作为相关性概率估计器和重排器评估。作者与生成模型和交叉编码器比较区分能力与 Brier 分数，再用校准后的概率为每个查询选择截断位置。结论适用于受测检索集。

papers.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models

summary.en: This audit compares five open Jev-style systems and generative baselines across confidence, stability and explanations. Reported provider confidence reflects the shape of the option distribution rather than observed correctness. Bundling questions can also alter answers, motivating separate validation of those interface properties.
summary.zh: 该审计比较五种开放 Jev 式系统及生成基线的置信度、稳定性和解释。报告中，接口置信度反映选项分布形状，与实测正确率口径不同。合并提问也可能改变答案，值得分别核验这些接口属性。

papers.title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model

summary.en: ZeroPoint trains a lightweight energy-based decision model to handle menus containing no acceptable answer. It compares a fixed rejection reference with a learned class and thresholded softmax. The results show the importance of training on examples in which no option fits.
summary.zh: ZeroPoint 训练轻量能量式决策模型，处理所有候选均不合适的菜单。论文比较固定拒判参照、学习得到的拒判类和设置阈值的 softmax。结果表明，使用无合适选项的样例进行训练很重要。

papers.title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions

summary.en: Omni-JEV maps text and two streams of speech to typed decisions about turn taking in voice interfaces. The authors compare classification accuracy and probability quality across alternatives. Its candidate actions include continuing, interrupting and resuming within the evaluated interaction protocol.
summary.zh: Omni-JEV 将文本与两路语音映射为语音界面的轮次决策。作者比较不同方案的分类准确率和概率质量。受测交互协议的候选动作包括继续、打断和恢复。

papers.title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard

summary.en: PolyRoute benchmarks typed routing in twelve languages and code-mixed input. It compares multilingual and English-derived decision models, including held-out languages. All texts and labels are generated, and statistical resolution is limited for small model differences.
summary.zh: PolyRoute 评估 12 种语言及混合语言输入上的类型化路由，比较多语和源自英语的决策模型，并包含留出语言。所有文本与标签均为生成数据，对较小模型差异的统计分辨力有限。

papers.title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics

summary.en: LEASH uses several decision gates to monitor potentially unsafe robot plans and actions against a shared policy. The authors test simulation and physical robots across multiple model backbones, reporting reductions in adverse outcomes while measuring task completion and overhead.
summary.zh: LEASH 用多道决策门控依据共用策略检查可能不安全的机器人计划和动作。作者在模拟与实体机器人上测试多种骨干，报告不良结果减少，并同时测量任务完成率与开销。

papers.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making

summary.en: MMDM evaluates decision models on a broad suite with joint constraints and tasks requiring more than one selected option. Some performance measures depend on recovering the complete valid set. The authors report that constraint planning and strict multiselect remain difficult.
summary.zh: MMDM 用大型任务集评估决策模型，包括联合约束和多选题。部分指标要求完整找出有效选项集合。作者报告，约束规划和严格多选仍然较难。

papers.title: Is Jev a Good Multilingual Judge?

summary.en: This work evaluates Jev as a judge across languages and task types, analyzing agreement alongside option probabilities. It reports weaker performance in some low-resource languages and examines whether probability outputs can help select which multilingual judgments deserve further review.
summary.zh: 论文按语言和任务评估 Jev 作为评判模型的表现，同时分析一致性与选项概率。作者报告部分低资源语言上的效果较弱，并检验概率是否能辅助筛选需要进一步复核的多语判断。

papers.title: Browser Immune System (BIS): Innate and Adaptive Threat Detection in the Browser with a Cybersecurity Transformer

summary.en: BIS explores defensive browser classification through a set of structured decisions about page content. Tests on a small public-page sample reveal false alarms on ordinary pages. The authors distinguish evaluation of the research checkpoint from evidence for a deployed browser extension.
summary.zh: BIS 通过对网页内容作出一组结构化判断探索防御性浏览器分类。少量公开网页测试发现普通页面也可触发误报。作者区分研究模型版本的评测与浏览器扩展部署所需的证据。

papers.title: JEV-VAD: Efficient Semantic Endpointing via Task-First Conditioning and Decoder-Prefix Pruning

summary.en: JEV-VAD applies an efficient decision readout to detecting when a speaker has finished an utterance. It compares decoder depth and conditioning choices on endpointing tasks, including cross-language transfer. Shallow computation can retain useful signal at lower resource use.
summary.zh: JEV-VAD 用高效决策读出检测说话者何时结束一句话。论文比较端点检测任务中的解码深度和条件设置，并测试跨语言迁移。较浅的计算可降低资源占用，同时保留有用的辨别信号。

papers.title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback

summary.en: This paper trains a calibrated decision head from selectively logged outcomes and evaluates calibration under simulated label noise. The authors test correction and validation-based stopping on held-out records. Noise experiments use a limited number of runs per rate.
summary.zh: 本文从选择性记录的结果训练校准决策头，并在模拟标签噪声下评估校准。作者在留出记录上测试修正方法和依赖验证集的早停。每种噪声率的实验运行次数有限。

papers.title: Can Model Answer Probabilities Represent Survey Populations? Conditional Prediction and Joint Validity in Jev Survey Simulation

summary.en: The authors evaluate whether Jev probabilities can represent population survey responses, distinguishing conditional predictions from joint events. Marginal checks can constrain possible results, while joint validity requires linked answers. Evidence is limited to selected binary questions and one model version.
summary.zh: 作者评估 Jev 概率能否表达人口调查回答，区分条件预测与联合事件。边际检验能约束可能结果，联合有效性仍需可关联的回答数据。证据限于选定的二元问题和一个模型版本。

papers.title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
