summary.en: Five typed decision heads are trained with a common backbone, datasets and protocol. They show similar in-domain accuracy while inference costs differ. Increasing the backbone from 0.6B to 4B yields larger gains, particularly on held-out data, in the reported comparison.
summary.zh: 研究以共同骨干、数据集和流程训练五种类型化决策头。各决策头的域内准确率相近，推断成本不同。报告中，将骨干从 0.6B 增至 4B 带来的收益更大，尤其是在留出数据上。

papers.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models

summary.en: The study compares quantization effects with output drift from engines, restarts, batches and kernels in two decision models. Aggregate accuracy can stay close while individual answers change. The authors report per-record outputs to support comparisons below the benchmark-average level.
summary.zh: 研究在两个决策模型上比较量化效应与推断引擎、重启、批次和内核引起的漂移。总体准确率接近时，个体答案仍可能改变。作者发布逐条输出，以支持基准均值以下层面的比较。

papers.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models

summary.en: SO-Arena benchmarks System One models across task capabilities and separately measures reliability of their responses. The model with the best performance is not the most reliable across tested conditions. The benchmark highlights model-selection trade-offs that a single score conceals.
summary.zh: SO-Arena 在不同任务能力维度上评估 System One 模型，并单独衡量回答可靠性。受测条件下，任务表现最佳的模型在可靠性上未居首。基准呈现了单一分数掩盖的选型权衡。

papers.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation

summary.en: This method adapts larger models into System One decision models with several possible exit depths. Confidence signals determine whether to compute additional layers. The paper compares accuracy and compute across seven benchmarks against models trained at fixed depths.
summary.zh: 该方法将较大的模型适配为可从不同深度退出的 System One 决策模型，由置信信号决定是否继续计算。论文在七个基准上与固定深度训练模型比较准确率和计算开销。

papers.title: CURATOR: Scalable Fine-grained Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Decision Models

summary.en: CURATOR applies decision models to fine-grained evidence selection for retrieval-augmented generation. The authors test discrimination as the number of candidates grows and measure downstream answers across domains. Reported gains are particularly relevant when the generator's context budget is small.
summary.zh: CURATOR 用决策模型完成检索增强生成中的细粒度证据选择。作者检验候选数增加时的区分能力，并跨领域衡量下游回答。生成器上下文预算较小时，报告中的收益尤其明显。

papers.title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores

summary.en: The authors examine confidence recalibration across Laya checkpoints and identify differences between stored settings and values used at runtime. Refit temperatures improve many checkpoints under random splits, with smaller gains on held-out sets. The experiments share an underlying labeling process.
summary.zh: 作者研究不同 Laya 检查点的置信度再校准，发现存储设定与运行时取值存在差异。重新拟合温度改善了随机划分下的多个检查点，留出集合上的收益较小。实验共用底层标注流程。

papers.title: Look Here, Then Decide: Small Decision Models in a Harness Find Memory-Safety Vulnerabilities at Scale on Commodity GPUs

summary.en: The authors evaluate small decision models as prioritization aids for defensive code review. They distinguish model judgments from independently verified findings and compare the resource requirements of evaluated deployments. Confirmed issues were handled through coordinated disclosure.
summary.zh: 作者评估小型决策模型在防御性代码审查中辅助安排优先级的能力，区分模型判断与经验证的发现，并比较受测部署的资源需求。确认的问题按协调披露流程处理。

papers.title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models

summary.en: This robustness study evaluates Jev and other System One models under adversarial evidence in benchmark tasks. The results include failures assigned high confidence and effects on downstream agent decisions, demonstrating that confidence alone can miss compromised judgments.
summary.zh: 该稳健性研究在基准任务中评估 Jev 等 System One 模型面对对抗性证据时的表现。结果包含高置信度错误及对下游智能体决定的影响，表明单靠置信度可能漏掉受干扰的判断。

papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models

summary.en: The hybrid decision model learns when the expected benefit of reasoning justifies further generation. Evaluation spans decision benchmarks and an agent environment. The paper reports several accuracy, latency and token-cost comparisons, including a direct comparison with hosted Jev on JevBench.
summary.zh: 该混合决策模型学习何时推理的预期收益值得继续生成。评估覆盖决策基准及一个智能体环境。论文报告准确率、延迟与词元成本对比，并在 JevBench 上直接比较托管 Jev。

papers.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents

summary.en: The authors compare decision models as actors, judges and teachers for long-horizon agents. They find weaknesses in direct action selection can coexist with useful retrospective feedback. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop measure the benefit of that feedback to an agent trained by reinforcement learning.
summary.zh: 作者比较决策模型作为长程智能体行动者、评判者和教师的表现。直接选择动作能力较弱时，事后反馈仍可能有价值。论文在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上测量反馈对强化学习智能体的帮助。

papers.title: S1Pert: Scalable Target-Specific Gene Response Prediction with System-One Intelligence

summary.en: S1Pert evaluates a System One-inspired model in a gene-response prediction benchmark. The authors compare predictive performance and inference efficiency across held-out cellular contexts, using historical response tendencies as a reference for assessing generalization in the studied datasets.
summary.zh: S1Pert 在基因反应预测基准中评估受 System One 启发的模型。作者在留出细胞情境中比较预测表现与推断效率，以历史反应趋势为参照衡量受测数据集中的泛化。

papers.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent

summary.en: LuthorSQL generates a candidate SQL query with a short decision-oriented path for use by a slower model. The study compares performance on standard and altered database schemas and probes memorization of public reference queries. Newly released databases provide a separate transfer check.
summary.zh: LuthorSQL 用短决策路径提出 SQL 候选，供较慢的模型使用。研究比较标准与经修改的数据库模式，并检查公开参考查询的记忆效应。较晚发布的数据库提供独立迁移检验。

papers.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications

summary.en: UltraBERT-JEV explores encoder architectures for single-pass decision workloads. The authors compare serving time and memory with an alternative and add an auxiliary readout for supporting sentences. Results show that lower latency can come with higher peak memory in the tested configuration.
summary.zh: UltraBERT-JEV 探索用于单次前向决策的编码器架构。作者比较服务耗时和内存，并加入预测支持证据句的辅助读出。受测配置中，较低延迟可能伴随较高的峰值内存。

papers.title: AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces

summary.en: AdaMenu selects a query-specific subset of labels before invoking a decision model. The authors compare accuracy and input-token consumption with full and hierarchical option sets. The approach also covers settings where a provider cannot accept the full label menu.
summary.zh: AdaMenu 调用决策模型前先按查询挑选标签子集。作者与完整菜单和层级菜单比较准确率及输入词元量。该方法也覆盖服务无法接受完整标签集合的设置。

papers.title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model

summary.en: SuperGlance evaluates a fast vision-language decision architecture for driving. Experiments include open-loop prediction and closed-loop simulation with controlled inference delays. Driving performance depends on the delay charged to the planner and the simulation's measured operating conditions.
summary.zh: SuperGlance 评估用于驾驶的快速视觉语言决策架构，涵盖开环预测以及控制推断延迟的闭环模拟。驾驶表现取决于计入规划器的延迟和模拟环境中的受测条件。

papers.title: Budgeted Decision-Model-Guided Joint-Action Search for Satellite Edge Computing

summary.en: This study uses a decision model to guide budgeted joint-action search for satellite edge-computing workloads. The simulation compares solver time and completion delay with several optimization baselines. Reported gains apply to the tested offloading scenarios and computational budget.
summary.zh: 研究用决策模型引导卫星边缘计算中受预算约束的联合动作搜索。模拟将求解耗时和任务时延与多个优化基线比较。报告收益适用于受测卸载场景与计算预算。

papers.title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0

summary.en: Program Distillation transfers policies from deliberative language models into executable student programs. PDBench compares those programs with reinforcement learning and Jev-like decision models on bounded control tasks. The paper reports both performance and deployment computation, including CPU-only operation.
summary.zh: Program Distillation 将慢速推理大模型的策略传给可执行学生程序。PDBench 在有界控制任务上对比程序、强化学习和 Jev 式决策模型。论文同时报告表现与部署计算情况，包括仅用 CPU 的运行。

papers.title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification

summary.en: AgenticJevNav verifies events with a decision model while searching for objects. The authors evaluate task completion in simulation and on a physical quadruped, with failures tied to visual grounding, approach planning and runtime. The real-robot experiment covers thirty trials.
summary.zh: AgenticJevNav 在搜寻物体时用决策模型验证事件。作者在模拟和实体四足机器人中评估任务完成情况，并分析视觉定位、接近规划与运行时间相关的失败。实体试验共 30 次。

papers.title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes

summary.en: The study measures accuracy, calibration and latency when decision models extract fields from cancer pathology reports. Explicit textual fields and numeric measurements present different difficulties. The paper reports field-specific errors and emphasizes validating the configuration used in the evaluation.
summary.zh: 研究衡量决策模型从癌症病理报告提取字段的准确率、校准和延迟。显式文本字段与数值测量的难度不同。论文报告具体字段的错误，并强调按实际配置验证。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers

summary.en: TDM-Gauntlet reuses splits, labels and metrics from 24 NLP papers to compare Jev and other typed decision models with task-trained classifiers. Jev matches the original model on 12 of 46 test sets zero-shot. Prompt optimization narrows the gap on others, with fine-tuning often stronger.
summary.zh: TDM-Gauntlet 沿用 24 篇 NLP 论文的数据划分、标签和指标，比较 Jev 等类型化决策模型与任务微调分类器。零样本 Jev 在 46 个测试集中的 12 个达到原模型水平。提示优化能缩小部分差距，微调往往仍更强。

papers.title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?

summary.en: The paper tests when a typed decision model benefits from representing relationships among options. It compares independent, attention-based and setwise approaches under varying supervision. Access to the candidate set is insufficient by itself, and useful transfer depends on task and training.
summary.zh: 论文检验类型化决策模型何时受益于表示候选之间的关系，对比独立打分、注意力和集合式方法在不同监督下的表现。只有候选访问权限并不足以保证有效比较，迁移效果取决于任务和训练。

papers.title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection

summary.en: This defensive benchmark compares System One models for malware classification using structured evidence. The authors report detection rates at several false-positive levels and inspect the judgments behind aggregate predictions. The measured rates depend on the chosen threshold and benchmark.
summary.zh: 该防御性基准比较 System One 模型利用结构化证据分类恶意软件的能力。作者报告不同误报率下的检出率，并检查总体预测背后的分项判断。实测结果取决于所选阈值及基准。

papers.title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: The authors test Jev probabilities as a safety reward for language-model training. They compare guard judgments and track confident errors as well as aggregate safety outcomes. The results show that a useful reward can still contain blind spots on difficult judgments.
summary.zh: 作者检验 Jev 概率能否作为语言模型训练的安全奖励，对比防护模型判断，并同时追踪高置信度错误与总体安全结果。实验表明，有用的奖励仍可能在困难判断上存在盲点。

papers.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding

summary.en: This MedJev model uses a vision-language backbone for single-pass decisions on medical images. The authors compare accuracy and end-to-end inference time with general and medical vision-language baselines. Its scope differs from the earlier MedJev zero-shot benchmark paper.
summary.zh: 这一 MedJev 模型基于视觉语言骨干对医学图像进行单次前向决策。作者与通用和医学视觉语言基线比较准确率及端到端推断耗时。该工作与较早的同名零样本基准研究范围不同。

papers.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI

summary.en: The System 1 Agents approach resolves local tool calls using typed decisions and a constrained argument interface. Its evaluation measures intent selection, stated argument completion and invented values against local generative agents. Results refer to the paper's tool and instruction set.
summary.zh: System 1 Agents 用类型化决策和受约束的参数接口解析本地工具调用。作者与本地生成智能体比较意图选择、已明确参数的填充和编造值。结果适用于论文中的工具及指令集合。

papers.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?

summary.en: The paper evaluates whether a model can predict that a user will request an edit and judge when a suggestion is worth showing. A learned decision gate improves accuracy among surfaced suggestions, with coverage controlled by the selected threshold.
summary.zh: 论文评估模型能否预测用户将提出编辑请求，并判断何时值得显示建议。学习得到的决策门控提高展示建议的准确率，覆盖量由所选阈值控制。

papers.title: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels

summary.en: This preregistered study measures whether additional personal email labels improve a typed decision classifier. Its learning curves compare adaptation seeds and report limitations on rare classes. Improvements in detecting minority categories are inconsistent across runs.
summary.zh: 该预注册研究检验增加个人邮件标签能否改善类型化决策分类器。学习曲线比较不同适配种子，并记录稀有类别的局限。少数类检出的改善在重复运行间不稳定。

papers.title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility

summary.en: Jetriever uses Jev probabilities to rank agent memories by their expected usefulness for a query, in place of similarity alone. It tests full-pool utility scoring on two memory benchmarks and reports answer gains alongside per-query retrieval costs.
summary.zh: Jetriever 用 Jev 概率按对查询的预期效用排序智能体记忆。研究在两个记忆基准上测试全候选池效用打分，并同时报告回答表现收益和每次检索成本。

papers.title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection

summary.en: FaceJev makes a direct visual decision about possible face forgery and supplies structured judgments about image regions. The authors compare performance on held-out manipulations and ablate the training components. The evaluation measures detection within the benchmark's image distributions.
summary.zh: FaceJev 对潜在人脸伪造进行直接视觉判断，并给出图像区域的结构化决策。作者比较留出操纵类型上的效果并消融训练组件。评测衡量基准图像分布中的检测表现。

papers.title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects

summary.en: The authors test whether decision models localize the visual abnormalities that they classify correctly. Built-in decision scores do not necessarily imply useful spatial maps. The paper compares several sources of localization signal with dedicated few-shot localizers.
summary.zh: 作者检验决策模型能否定位自己正确识别的视觉异常。内置决策分数并不必然对应可用的空间图。论文将几种定位信号与专门的少样本定位器比较。

papers.title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding

summary.en: SpecSearch compares search and Jev-based prediction of efficient speculative-decoding settings across hardware. The decision-guided version approaches the throughput from full measurement while avoiding a held-out hardware calibration stage in the reported experiments.
summary.zh: SpecSearch 比较跨硬件搜索和用 Jev 预测高效推测解码配置的方法。报告实验中，决策引导版本的吞吐量接近完整测量，同时省去独立的硬件校准阶段。

papers.title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness

summary.en: This study uses a slower model to refine a harness that executes fast typed decisions. It evaluates performance, serving delay and the cost of intermediate development interventions. The authors report that the need for those interventions falls over successive harness updates.
summary.zh: 该研究用慢速模型改进执行快速类型化决策的运行框架，评估任务表现、服务延迟及开发干预成本。作者报告随着框架多轮更新，需要的慢模型干预逐步减少。

papers.title: Right Diagnosis, Unsafe Route: Auditing Clinical AI Decision Trajectories and Corrective Oversight for Validity and Potential Harm

summary.en: The study evaluates clinical decision trajectories alongside their final diagnoses and compares different forms of oversight. Correcting an early error can improve the next decision while introducing new risk later in the trace. The evaluation distinguishes final accuracy from trajectory safety.
summary.zh: 研究同时评估临床决策轨迹和最终诊断，并比较不同监督方式。纠正早期错误可以改善下一步，但轨迹后段仍可能出现新风险。评测区分最终准确率与过程安全。

papers.title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology

summary.en: SlideJev answers typed questions about whole-slide pathology using tissue grounding and order-stable candidate processing. The evaluation changes option order and uses mismatched or missing images as controls. The reported accuracy gains are tied to using the appropriate tissue evidence.
summary.zh: SlideJev 通过组织证据定位和顺序稳定的候选处理回答全切片病理问题。评测调换选项顺序，并用不匹配或缺失图像作对照。报告中的准确率收益与正确组织证据有关。

papers.title: When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control

summary.en: The paper evaluates typed decision models in two transportation settings, travel choice and traffic signal control. Experiments assess how input descriptions and task requirements affect zero-shot choices. The authors report distinct limitations and opportunities for the two applications.
summary.zh: 论文在出行选择和交通信号控制中评估类型化决策模型，检验输入描述及任务要求如何影响零样本选择。作者分别报告两类应用中的机会和局限。

papers.title: Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?

summary.en: The authors compare decision and generative models for contact-center classification and judging. Besides aggregate accuracy, they analyze cost, abstention and option-position effects. Smaller decision models show particularly large losses on some judging tasks in the tested workflows.
summary.zh: 作者在呼叫中心分类与评判任务中比较决策模型和生成模型，除总体准确率外还分析成本、拒判和选项位置效应。在受测工作流中，较小决策模型在部分评判任务上的降幅尤其明显。

papers.title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing

summary.en: RagHarnessDebugger records repair decisions made by a Jev-guided contract-inference pipeline. The audit checks the completeness and linkage of traces and examines how missed repairs affect answers on ContractNLI. The work treats decision visibility as an evaluation target alongside final accuracy.
summary.zh: RagHarnessDebugger 记录 Jev 引导的合同推断流程中的修复决策。审计检查轨迹是否完整、关联是否正确，并观察修复遗漏如何影响 ContractNLI 回答。研究将决策可见性与最终准确率一并评估。

papers.title: JEV vs. LLMs: A Comparative Analysis for Phishing Email Detection

summary.en: This phishing-email benchmark compares Jev with generative models on classification, latency and probability calibration. Jev performs well on several measured triage dimensions. The study does not evaluate generated explanations, and the tested dataset supports only a bounded comparison.
summary.zh: 该钓鱼邮件基准比较 Jev 与生成模型的分类、延迟和概率校准。Jev 在若干受测初筛指标上表现较好。生成式解释超出该评测范围，数据仅支持有界比较。

papers.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate

summary.en: Jeveration extends a System One-oriented architecture to support image generation, visual understanding and dense prediction in one checkpoint. The authors compare quality, speed and predictive performance of its single-pass approach with prior unified systems on designated tasks.
summary.zh: Jeveration 扩展面向 System One 的架构，让同一检查点支持图像生成、视觉理解和密集预测。作者在指定任务上比较单次前向方案与既有统一系统的质量、速度和预测表现。

papers.title: VisualJevBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Visual Typed Decision Models

summary.en: VisualJevBench evaluates visual typed decisions with Jev and documents robustness under altered input images. The reported failures vary by evaluation condition and by transfer setting. Its benchmark makes it possible to evaluate visual decision reliability separately from clean-input accuracy.
summary.zh: VisualJevBench 使用 Jev 评估视觉类型化决策，并记录输入图像变化下的稳健性。报告中的失效情况随评测条件和迁移设置变化。基准可将视觉决策可靠性与干净输入准确率分别衡量。

papers.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models

summary.en: The study evaluates multimodal System One models for bias when answer evidence and supplied descriptions vary. The authors examine both changes in chosen answers and probability shifts for cases where the answer stays the same. Accuracy alone can obscure differences between inputs.
summary.zh: 论文在答案证据和输入描述发生变化时评估多模态 System One 模型的偏差。作者同时比较所选答案变化以及答案不变时的概率偏移。仅看准确率可能掩盖输入间的差异。

papers.title: WaterSheep 0.1.0: Typed Decisions with Calibrated Probabilities from a Single Encoder Pass

summary.en: WaterSheep fine-tunes ModernBERT with a decision head and question-type temperature scaling for Noul, Choice, Score, and multi-label probabilities. The author's project documentation reports 77.8% in-distribution accuracy and 61.2% on held-out datasets, with ECE of 0.026 and 0.043. It is included as an open Jev-style model with a compatible API; English-only support, input truncation, and weaker rating performance limit its use. The DOI verifies preprint metadata; this summary relies on project documentation because the paper's full text was inaccessible.
summary.zh: WaterSheep 在 ModernBERT 上微调决策头，并按问题类型进行温度缩放，为 Noul、Choice、Score 和多标签任务输出概率。作者项目说明报告分布内准确率为 77.8%，留出数据集准确率为 61.2%，对应 ECE 为 0.026 和 0.043。本文作为开放的 Jev 风格模型被收录，并提供兼容接口；仅支持英语、长输入截断和评分任务表现较弱限制了其用途。DOI 已确认预印本元数据；由于论文全文无法访问，本摘要依据作者项目说明整理。

papers.title: Deciding Without Generating: A Survey of Typed Decision Models, from Jev to Open Decision LLMs

summary.en: This survey formalizes typed decisions and reviews the training, serving and evaluation literature around Jev and open alternatives. It distinguishes probabilities used for routing from empirical correctness and examines how fallback decisions affect overall accuracy. Findings synthesize evidence from the surveyed work.
summary.zh: 该综述形式化定义类型化决策，回顾 Jev 及开放替代模型的训练、服务和评测文献。作者区分用于路由的概率与实测正确性，并分析后备模型的决定如何影响整体准确率。结论综合自所述文献。

papers.title: Decision Models as L2 Rerankers for Content-Based Recommendation: A Pre-Registered Evaluation

summary.en: This preregistered evaluation uses hosted Jev as a second-stage product reranker. It compares retrieved and more completely judged lists on Amazon ESCI and Wayfair WANDS. Jev improves on embedding order, while stronger trained cross-encoders erase most of its advantage in the tested settings.
summary.zh: 该预注册评测用托管 Jev 对商品进行第二阶段重排，在 Amazon ESCI 和 Wayfair WANDS 上比较检索候选及标注更完整的列表。Jev 优于嵌入排序，但在受测设置中较强的已训练交叉编码器抵消了大部分优势。

papers.title: Title and Abstract Screening for Systematic Reviews with Jev, a Decision Model: Comparison with Generative Large Language Models

summary.en: The authors compare Jev with generative models on title and abstract screening for two reviews of bipolar disorder treatments. Jev retained every ultimately included report in the tested runs at low measured cost. It still excluded some records flagged for human full-text review.
summary.zh: 作者在两项双相障碍治疗综述的题名和摘要筛选中比较 Jev 与生成模型。受测运行中，Jev 以较低实测成本保留所有最终纳入报告，但仍排除了部分人工筛查认为应阅读全文的记录。

papers.title: Nano-jev: Calibrated Cross-Encoder Micro-Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Confidence Cascading

summary.en: Nano-jev uses a small cross-encoder to score relevance, evidence sufficiency and answer groundedness as typed decisions. The authors compare it with specialized checkers and test a confidence cascade. Transfer to unseen datasets reduces both accuracy and calibration quality.
summary.zh: Nano-jev 用小型交叉编码器对相关性、证据充分性和回答依据作类型化判断。作者与专用检查器比较，并测试置信度级联。迁移到未见数据时，准确率和校准质量均下降。

papers.title: Decision-only medical AI: early evidence and pairing with language models

summary.en: This medRxiv preprint tests Jev and another decision service on clinical examples with altered framing, then measures a paired workflow using a generative model. Pairing reduces some framing effects while maintaining similar triage accuracy in the controlled evaluation.
summary.zh: 这篇 medRxiv 预印本用改变表述的临床样例评估 Jev 和另一决策服务，并测试与生成模型配对的工作流。在受控实验中，配对减少部分表述影响，分诊准确率保持接近。

papers.title: Scoring the NIH Stroke Scale from bedside exam transcripts: a synthetic benchmark of a decision model and a large language model

summary.en: The authors compare a decision model with a language model for scoring stroke-scale items from synthetic examination transcripts. The generative model is more accurate, while the decision model is faster and cheaper. A simulated cascade tests whether lower-confidence items can be escalated selectively.
summary.zh: 作者比较决策模型和语言模型如何根据合成查体记录评定卒中量表条目。生成模型准确率较高，决策模型速度较快、费用较低。模拟级联测试能否选择性复核低置信度条目。

papers.title: A decision-only model as a low-cost judge of medical AI answers

summary.en: This medRxiv study evaluates Jev as a low-cost judge of generated medical answers against other models and expert agreement. The authors report lower serving cost and competitive results on many evaluated tasks, with weaker performance on some error-detection tests.
summary.zh: 这项 medRxiv 研究评估 Jev 作为低成本医学答案评判模型的表现，并与其他模型和专家一致性比较。报告显示其服务成本较低，在许多任务上具有竞争力，但在部分错误检测实验中较弱。
